tags.hidden-title: PaperTrail AI — Production Operations & SRE Dashboard

content.Query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ContainerAppName_s == 'papertrail-api' | extend LogData = parse_json(Log_s) | where LogData.component == 'api' | summarize TotalRequests = count(), Errors = countif(toint(LogData.http_status) >= 400) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | render timechart

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) | extend LogData = parse_json(Log_s) | where LogData.operation == 'state_transition' | summarize Count = count() by State = tostring(LogData.target_state) | render barchart

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(12h) | extend LogData = parse_json(Log_s) | where LogData.operation in ('adapter_completed', 'audit_chain_sealed', 'report_generated') | summarize AvgDurationMs = avg(todouble(LogData.duration_ms)), P95Ms = percentile(todouble(LogData.duration_ms), 95) by Adapter = coalesce(tostring(LogData.adapter), tostring(LogData.component)) | render columnchart

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(12h) | extend LogData = parse_json(Log_s) | where LogData.severity in ('ERROR', 'WARNING') or isnotempty(LogData.error_category) | summarize Count = count() by ErrorCategory = tostring(LogData.error_category), Component = tostring(LogData.component) | render piechart

ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | extend LogData = parse_json(Log_s) | where LogData.target_state == 'COMPLETED' or LogData.operation == 'report_generated' | summarize CompletedAt = max(TimeGenerated), FinalRevision = max(toint(LogData.workflow_revision)), ReportId = take_anyif(tostring(LogData.report_id), isnotempty(LogData.report_id)) by WorkflowId = tostring(LogData.workflow_id) | order by CompletedAt desc | take 15
